messages.content:
You formalize German traffic rules as temporal-logic formulae over the physical state of the world.

OUTPUT FORMAT: exactly one YAML document (no surrounding prose, no code fences) with keys: rule_id, description, sampling_rate_hz, horizon, constants, environment (signals with name/sort), formula.

FORMULA LANGUAGE (strict fragment — anything else is rejected):
- outermost operator must be G( ... )
- Boolean: and, or, not, ->
- temporal: F[a,b](...), H[a,b](...), O[a,b](...) with integer step bounds
- atoms: linear comparisons (<=, >=, <, >) over declared signals, declared
  constants, numbers, abs(...); NO signal*signal products, NO nested G,
  NO unbounded operators.
- bare boolean signals are atoms.

Declare every quantity you use (true gap, true velocity, hazard-light
state, ...) as an environment signal; name numeric parameters as constants.
The formula ranges over the state of the world, not over any software
architecture.

EXAMPLE (synthetic watchdog rule -- study the exact YAML shape):
rule_id: SYN_watchdog_flat
description: A warning shall follow a sustained runaway torque command.
sampling_rate_hz: 10
horizon: 8
constants:
  T_MAX: 3.0
environment:
  signals:
    - {name: torque_cmd, sort: real}
    - {name: warn, sort: bool}
formula: "G((torque_cmd >= T_MAX) -> F[0,3](warn))"

Formalize the following rule as a single formula document.
Rule: Unnecessary braking (StVO §4(1)): vehicles must not brake abruptly without reason. Interpret at feature level: a commanded deceleration stronger than 2.0 m/s^2 is only permitted when the gap to the preceding vehicle is critical (below 20.0 m).
Context: Perception estimates the gap with a bounded error of 2.0 m; the plant tracks the commanded acceleration within 0.5 m/s^2.
Use rule_id: R_G2_flat. Output only the YAML document.

content:
rule_id: R_G2_flat
description: Unnecessary braking (StVO §4(1)): vehicles must not brake abruptly without reason.
sampling_rate_hz: 10
horizon: 8
constants:
  MAX_DECEL: 2.0
  MAX_GAP: 20.0
  GAP_ERROR: 2.0
  ACCEL_ERROR: 0.5
environment:
  signals:
    - {name: gap, sort: real}
    - {name: commanded_deceleration, sort: real}
    - {name: preceding_vehicle_in_front, sort: bool}
formula: "G((commanded_deceleration > MAX_DECEL) -> (preceding_vehicle_in_front -> F[0,1](gap <= MAX_GAP - GAP_ERROR)))"
